description: Source code implementing a class and function to break variable aliasing in inner loops for shader compilation, specifically for the ANGLE project. It modifies the AST to add '+0' to certain assignments within nested loops to work around a bug in HLSL compiler aliasing.

classes.name: AliasingBreaker
classes.description: A traverser class that modifies AST nodes to break variable aliasing chains in nested loops.

methods.name: BreakVariableAliasingInInnerLoops
methods.description: Main function that applies the aliasing breaker to the AST and validates it.
